# anthropic_workspace_rate_limits (Data Source)

List a workspace's rate limits.

By default, returns only the groups and limiter types that have a workspace-level override. With `query.include_inherited = true`, returns every group with organization-level limits the workspace can see, listing for each the values it inherits from the organization as well as its own overrides. Each value's source says which it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_workspace_rate_limits" "example" {
  workspace_id = "wrkspc_xxxxx"

  # Optional query parameters to filter the results.
  query = {
    include_inherited = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the workspace.

### Optional

- `query` (Attributes) Query filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query))

### Read-Only

- `workspace_rate_limits` (Attributes List) The rate limits for the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_rate_limits))

<a id="nestedatt--query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query`

Optional:

- `group_type` (String) Filter by group type. Value must be one of : `batch`, `files`, `model_group`, `skills`, `token_count`, `web_search`.
- `include_inherited` (Boolean) Also list the limiter values the workspace inherits from the organization, including groups with no workspace-level override.


<a id="nestedatt--workspace_rate_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_rate_limits`

Read-Only:

- `group` (Attributes) The rate-limit group this entry's limits apply to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_rate_limits--group))
- `limits` (Attributes List) The workspace's limiter values for this group. By default only the limiter types with a workspace-level override are listed. With `query.include_inherited` set to `true`, the limiter types the workspace inherits from the organization are listed too, each marked by `source`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_rate_limits--limits))
- `models` (List of String) Model names this entry's limits apply to, including aliases. `null` when `group_type` is not `"model_group"`.
- `rate_limit_id` (String) The `id` of the organization's RateLimit entry this entry applies to.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the Workspace this entry applies to.

<a id="nestedatt--workspace_rate_limits--group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_rate_limits.group`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name of the model group (for example, `Claude Sonnet 4.x`). For display only; it may change. Only available when `type = "model_group"`.
- `id` (String) The ID of the group.
- `type` (String) The type of the group.


<a id="nestedatt--workspace_rate_limits--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_rate_limits.limits`

Read-Only:

- `org_limit` (Number) The organization-level value for the same limiter type, for reference. `null` when the organization has no limit configured for this limiter type.
- `source` (Attributes) Where `value` comes from. `organization` values are listed only when `query.include_inherited` is `true`, and then `value` equals `org_limit`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_rate_limits--limits--source))
- `type` (String) The limiter type (for example, `requests_per_minute` or `input_tokens_per_minute`).
- `value` (Number) The workspace's value for this limiter type: the workspace-level override when `source.type` is `workspace`, otherwise the organization's value.

<a id="nestedatt--workspace_rate_limits--limits--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_rate_limits.limits.source`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of the source.
